scope_support.exclusion_quote: we study a simple periodic intervention, fork-and-flush.
scope_support.feedback_quote: After running each trajectory for a fixed horizon, the agent continues from the highest-scoring one.
scope_support.object_quote: Our method forks the agent into parallel trajectories, each inheriting the accumulated workspace but starting with a fresh chat context.
